newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 1.5 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 1.5 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 1.5 percent in the week ended May 24 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
The year-over-year percentage change of the adjusted index advanced 1.1 percent during the last reporting week. The month-to-date index slipped 0.2 percent from the prior month.
"Unfavorable weather continued to be the chief complaint heard by the major retailers -- particularly among the discounters," the report said.
